response.original_title: HARASHIMA凱旋！～また青梅で大会やるさー！なんでー？地元だからだー！～
response.overview: HARASHIMA's Homecoming! ~We're Back in Ome! Why? Because It's My Hometown!~ was a professional wrestling event promoted by DDT Pro-Wrestling. It was held on September 23, 2026 at Sumitomo Metal Mine Arena Ome in Ōme, Tokyo, Japan, in the hometown of DDT legend HARSAHIMA.
